sources.title: Zero-Shot Personalized Camera Motion Control for Image-to-Video Synthesis
sources.snippet: To address this, we present a zero-shot diffusion-based framework for personalized camera motion control, enabling the transfer of cinematic movements from a single reference video onto a user-provided static image without requiring 3D data, predefined trajectories, or complex graphical interfaces.
